notes: Account background: mid-market product search provider (SaaS) used by retailers for product discovery and support
Primary ask: replace current handcrafted rerank rules with model-based rerank endpoint; want predictable latency + offline eval framework
POC scope: 2-week offline scoring then small online A/B on subset of traffic (10%)
Traffic/targets: expect ~80-150 qps peak on search rerank path; target latency p95 <= 120ms for the rerank call when in hosted mode; throughput burst tolerance requested
Quality metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, CTR lift on top-3 — engineering wants automatic monitoring + regression alerts
Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. Will trade some latency for cost savings. Interested in quantization recommendations and batching tips from Redwood Optimize
Model preferences: prefer open model variants; will accept Redwood-curated quantized variants. Need fallback to smaller model if Dedicated capacity degraded
Routing needs: region-aware routing to NA for latency; eventual fallbacks to cheaper zone during off-peak
Security: SSO (SAML) required for admin console; audit logs and KMS for key management; retention controls for PII; SOC2 required by procurement
Quote from Head of Product: 'We need consistent relevance improvements and a path to predictable unit costs. Show us a net win vs rules and a simple way to measure regression.'
Quote from Infra lead: 'If Dedicated is too expensive we'll consider hybrid: hosted for dev, dedicated for prod rerank pool.'
Open items: finalize POC eval set (samples provided but need labeling metrics), SAML attribute mapping, committed Dedicated nodes pricing
use_case_summary: Replacing rules-based rerank with model-based reranking endpoint. Focused on offline eval sets + repeatable scoring, maintain p95 latency <=120ms in hosted evaluation; evaluate Dedicated for production throughput and cost predictability. Require SSO, audit logging, KMS, and measurable regression detection.
notes_short: Mid-market search SaaS. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API POC for reranking; moving toward Dedicated if ARR and latency targets met. Security + pricing are primary blockers.
sales_notes: AE: Maya - strong exec sponsor (Head of Product). SE: Liam - technical lead on POC. Procurement loop expects SOC2 and standard contract redlines. Pricing ask: 6-month committed Dedicated estimate to compare vs pay-as-you-go hosted.
technical_requirements: Rerank endpoint with candidate scoring API, support for batch offline scoring (csv/json), SDK for incremental evals, metrics hooks (NDCG/MRR), low-latency model variants, autoscaling for burst traffic, KV cache for prefix caching
poC_details: 2-week POC: week1 offline scoring across 50k queries + eval set; week2 pilot 10% traffic A/B with traffic split and metrics collection. Deliverables: eval report, latency/cost numbers, recommended Dedicated sizing
decision_criteria: 1) >=10% NDCG@10 uplift vs current rules 2) p95 latency <=120ms in production-like environment 3) predictable unit cost to fit $50k-$150k ARR model 4) Security checklist passed (SAML + audit logs)
historical_contact: Maya Chen (AE) initial outreach from webinar; Liam O'Connor (SE) technical deep dives; Head of Product (quote in notes) involved in final decision
